[docs/resource-guides/aws/custom.md#other-aws-services-type-custom]
`custom` is for any service that isn't a bucket, queue, topic, database or cache: DynamoDB, Secrets Manager, Kinesis, EventBridge, Bedrock, a third-party API. pskit only passes its details to your functions (`external: true` is required). pskit grants **no IAM permissions** for `custom` resources: add them under `provider.iam.statements`. Use `${tf:...}` only for resources you also define in `provider.terraform.extra`; for console-created ones, paste the ARN.

[docs/resource-guides/aws/database.md#networking-first]
An RDS instance lives in a VPC. pskit deploys Lambda functions **outside any VPC** unless you set `functions.<fn>.options.vpc_config` (merged into `aws_lambda_function`). Pick one: A Lambda in a VPC has no internet access and can't reach AWS APIs (SQS, S3, Secrets Manager, ...) unless the subnets have a NAT gateway or VPC endpoints.

[docs/resource-guides/aws/queue.md#3-declare-it-in-pskityml]
- looks the queue up by name (`data "aws_sqs_queue"`) in the deploy account and region, - creates an event source mapping (`batch_size`, `batch_window`, partial batch failures) for `worker`, - adds `sqs:SendMessage`, `ReceiveMessage`, `DeleteMessage`, ... on the queue ARN to the functions' IAM role, - sets `PSKIT_RESOURCE_JOBS_ARN` and `PSKIT_RESOURCE_JOBS_URL`.

[docs/resource-guides/aws/storage.md#3-declare-it-in-pskityml]
What pskit does with it: looks the bucket up by name (`data "aws_s3_bucket"`), allows S3 to invoke the function, creates an `aws_s3_bucket_notification` on the bucket, adds `s3:GetObject`, `PutObject`, `DeleteObject`, `ListBucket` (bucket and `/*`) to the IAM role of bound functions, and sets `PSKIT_RESOURCE_INVOICES_ARN`.

[docs/resource-guides/aws/topic.md#3-declare-it-in-pskityml]
What pskit does with it: looks the topic up by name (`data "aws_sns_topic"`), creates a Lambda subscription for `notify` with the filter policy, allows SNS to invoke it, adds `sns:Publish` on the topic to the IAM role of bound functions, and sets `PSKIT_RESOURCE_ORDER_EVENTS_ARN`. `pskit remove` deletes the subscription, never the topic.
